description: An account's escrows, payment channels and checks by direction, its deposit preauthorizations, tickets and owner reserve, and what blocks deleting it. When to use: Before deleting or winding down an account: to see which escrows can be finished or cancelled now, how much XRP is left in its payment channels, which checks expire soon, how much XRP its owned objects lock in reserve, and which owned entries block AccountDelete. Prefer another tool: To list the open DEX offers and how funded each one is (use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/offers`) or the trust lines (use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/lines`); for the balance and owner count, use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/summary`. Example: xrpl_account_commitments {"address":"rGAs3npYy1VwLPE92kvKvA2QYLR6FSA9n6"}

address.description: Valid classic XRPL account address (r..., checksum verified)

name: xrpl_account_commitments

age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

in.description: Checks toward the account (it is the destination)

expired.description: Checks whose Expiration is at or before the validated ledger close time; null when the validated ledger close time could not be read and an object of this direction has the time field it reads

expiring_within_24h.description: Checks whose Expiration falls after the validated ledger close time and at most 24 hours after it; null when the validated ledger close time could not be read and an object of this direction has the time field it reads

out.description: Checks the account created (it is the source)

checks_failed.description: Reads that failed, each leaving the fields that need it null: `objects` (a later page), `account`, `reserves`, `ledger`; empty when none failed

deletion_blockers.description: Owned entries that block deleting the account; a total of 0 alone does not make it deletable: its sequence age, the number of objects it owns, the NFTs it minted, the fee and the destination's own rules also decide

by_type.description: Count per account_objects type of the owned entries that block AccountDelete, keys in alphabetical order, types with no entry omitted; every type blocks except offer, signer_list, ticket, deposit_preauth, nft_offer, did, oracle, credential and delegate, which are deleted with the account

lower_bound.description: True when truncated: the counts cover the pages read only

by_credentials.description: Preauthorizations of a set of credentials

escrows.description: Escrows by direction; an escrow to the account itself counts as out only

in.description: Escrows toward the account (it is the destination)

cancelable_now.description: Escrows whose CancelAfter has passed; null when the validated ledger close time could not be read and an object of this direction has the time field it reads

finishable_now.description: Escrows without a Condition whose FinishAfter has passed (or that have none) and whose CancelAfter has not; null when the validated ledger close time could not be read and an object of this direction has the time field it reads

next_release_at.description: Earliest FinishAfter not yet passed (conditional escrows included), ISO 8601 UTC; null when none, or when the close time could not be read and an escrow has a FinishAfter

totals.description: Amount held per asset, in first-appearance order; XRP in XRP, not drops; an MPT in base units

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes
